relations.title: The Map and The Flow
relations.reading: Independent dependency and attribution records provide a concrete comparison for the distinction between found flow and declared representation.

relations.title: How to Measure the Cost of Not Knowing
relations.reading: The cost of obtaining clarity and the contribution of the capability being examined require separate measures and independent interpretations.

relations.title: Information Management as Operational Tracking
relations.reading: The information model can preserve separate dependency and attribution channels, allowing the Attribution Gap protocol to test their divergence without building it into the data.

relations.title: Tacit Knowledge Management in Distributed Tiger Teams
relations.reading: Tacit-knowledge concentration can inform a contribution estimate when tied to observable exception handling and replacement conditions rather than reputation.

relations.title: Tiger Team Maturity Model

relations.title: The Formación Integral © JubAp.Net (JubAp.Net) School of Invisible Talent

relations.title: Barcelona, Cuba, California, Veracruz: Urban Mobility, Swarm Intelligence and Constraint-Driven Architecture
relations.reading: The independent occupancy channel illustrates the measurement discipline behind separating operational evidence from strategically asserted claims, while retaining each instrument's error model.

relations.title: Field Intelligence in Chicontepec and the Texas–Mérida Corridor
relations.reading: A cross-border follow-up should establish whether the same capability was retained, transferred, duplicated or lost before applying an attribution-gap explanation.

relations.title: Entropy, Capability Activation and Sociotechnical Engineering
relations.reading: The activation study should be assembled before outcomes are known, retaining failed reorganizations and absolute capability benchmarks rather than selecting only impressive survivors.

relations.title: El cliclo de la frontera: de Exploradores a Explotadores
relations.reading: The attribution protocol could help distinguish symbolic prestige from the budget, ownership and decision rights needed to keep an exploratory capability operational.

relations.reading: Contribution measurement should separate the reference outcome, the evaluated decision process and the credit assigned, rather than feeding the desired verdict into the measurement.

relations.title: ACC — Architectural fidelity review of recent experiments
relations.reading: Attribution measures should preserve their separate dimensions; improvement in one coordinate does not automatically compensate for an unmeasured or worsening coordinate elsewhere.
